window: Covering reporting published since the Sept 9 edition, roughly Sept 8-10. A prolonged outage of the search tool cut this run's research time roughly in half, which especially thinned the Rest of World sweep (Africa, Asia and Europe searches mostly returned nothing new after the outage began) — treat today's world coverage as partial rather than a sign little happened elsewhere. South America still got dedicated effort in Spanish and Portuguese. Excluded as stale, duplicate or too thin: a Colombian Navy 736 kg Cartagena cocaine bust already logged Sept 3; a 413 kg Riohacha interdiction and a Spanish 11-ton salt-shipment cocaine bust that both turned out to be from earlier in the year; an Arizona 233 lb cocaine stop and a Pharr, Texas 908 lb meth seizure that were several months old despite appearing in current search results; a Rhode Island 41 kg fentanyl bust that dates to 2021; a Martin County, Florida cocaine sting and an Australian Operation Minjiang arrest that both traced back to mid-August; a vague, unsourced hoodline.com item citing a DEA Seattle Ecuador seizure with no confirmable date or agency detail; and an Orlando fentanyl-and-cocaine sentencing already several days old. No further development emerged in Uruguay's Artigas cocaine-airdrop case.

stories.headline: Massachusetts — twin Hyde Park searches net fentanyl, crack cocaine and a high-capacity magazine, two arrested
stories.summary: Boston police searched two homes on Georgetowne Drive in the Hyde Park neighborhood on September 8 and arrested 26-year-old Joshua Lewis and 41-year-old Brian Lender.

stories.headline: Bolivia — highway stop nets 26.6 kilos of cocaine as a wider crackdown grounds more than 80 trafficking aircraft
stories.summary: Bolivia's anti-narcotics police (FELCN) stopped a vehicle on the Challapata-Uyuni highway on September 8 and found 35 packages of cocaine weighing about 26.6 kilograms.
